Barney Frank, who has a lot of experience in politics, recently spoke in Chicago to a full crowd at the Center on Halsted. He shared stories from his four years in public service. Frank was the first member of Congress to marry someone of the same sex while still in office. and he also spoke strongly against politicians who hide their sexuality and vote against LGBT rights. When someone in the audience asked about a California ballot measure that would allow killing gay people, Frank said he didn’t know about the proposal. But he told the young person not to worry about " crazy people."

A violent attack on Garissa University College in Kenya has killed almost 50 people, including students, and left many others injured. Armed men stormed the campus early Thursday during morning prayers, opening fire randomly and taking people hostage before being killed by security forces. Officials said. The U.S. Embassy in Nairobi reported that Al-Shabaab militants claimed responsibility. This shocking attack happened just months after Al-Shabaab killed non-Muslim workers at a quarry in Kenya. the group has carried out many attacks in the area. It has also recruited some Americans, especially from the Somali-American community in Minnesota.

A South African university is celebrating the removal of a statue of British colonialist Cecil Rhodes, after weeks of protests. The University of Cape Town students used social media to call for the statue to be taken down, say his history is linked to racism. They started a campaign using the hashtag #RhodesMustFall, which began last month. Four weeks later, the hashtag is now #RhodesHas Fallen. The university said on Wednesday that the heritage authority gave permission to remove the statue. from campus. The university added that the removal was to keep the statue safe while decisions are made about what to do with it in the future.

CNN says Syria is like hell and is getting worse. The number of people killed there has doubled in one year, according to an opposition group. Since the civil war began, 310000 people have died, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR). That number is up from 162402, which was the death toll a year earlier. The year before, the United Nations said about 70000 people had died. The UN says more than half of all Syrians are now in terrible poverty and need urgent help to survive.. Food aid is being reduced because there aren't enough donations.

(Ailina Tsarnaeva walked into Manhattan Criminal Court quietly and nearly shyly, but prosecutors say she was not afraid when it came to a woman she saw as a rival. According to a criminal complaint, Tsarnaeva made a threatening phone call this summer, saying, "Leave my man alone. Stop looking for him. I know people who can put a bomb where you live." Because of who she is — the sister of Dzhokhar and Tamerlan Tsarnaev — prosecutors said that threat was not a joke. She was charged with aggravated harassment, which she denies. Last December, after leaving court, she and her lawyer would not talk about the case.

A door painted with graffiti by British artist Banksy was taken by police in Gaza on Thursday after a dispute over its sale. a Gaza police official told CNN. The door’s owner, Rabea Darduna, said he didn’t know how valuable it was and sold it for just $175 U.S. The iron door will stay with the Khan Younis police in southern Gaza until a court hearing, which has not yet been scheduled. Darduna said his home in Gaza was destroyed during last summer’s war, and he felt he had nothing left—only a doorway and a door.

CNN reported that the fighting against the Houthis rebels in Yemen continued on Tuesday. The Saudi-led coalition said it was gaining more control, as people fled the violence and the death toll rose—dozens of those killed were civilians. Five days after the first airstrikes, the coalition had destroyed most of the Houthis' and their allies' air defense systems, and made almost all air bases and runways unusable, according to a Saudi source. Saudi Arabia's navy now controls all Yemeni ports, and only non-military medical supplies are allowed through the blockade, the source said.

Holland's manager Guus Hiddink criticized his own fans for booing Andres Iniesta during Holland's 2-0 win over Spain on Tuesday. He called the fans' behavior a "disgrace." Spain played a weaker team, with Iniesta coming on in the 7venty-minute and being greeted with loud boos by the home crowd. Iniesta, who started on the bench, was not well received. Holland's defenders Stefan de Vrij and Davy Klaassen scored in the first half to help secure the win.. Hiddink was upset by how Iniesta was treated, even though he was on the opposing team. Iniesta played in the match, which Holland won 2-0.

On May 21, Scotland will find out if their September 2016 Euro 2016 qualifier against Georgia will be played without fans. UEFA has started a disciplinary process against the Georgian Football Federation (GFF) because of two incidents where fans went onto the pitch during Georgia's 0-2 loss to Germany in Tbilisi on Sunday. UEFA is also investigating claims that fans set off fireworks, and there will be a separate review into safety problems at the Boris Paichadze Stadium, including blocked stairs, locked gates, and staff not doing body searches. A fan ran onto the pitch during the match in Tbilisi.

On Wednesday, football agents were unsure what to expect while waiting for new rules. Starting April 1, anyone can become a football agent by paying £500 for a one-year registration.. The Football Association (FA) will then charge £250 per year after that. The FA says that existing licensed agents don’t need to follow the new rules. The FA was supposed to put a link on its website so intermedi could register, but as of 1pm, that link was still not there. Mel Stein believes the new rules will cause chaos. The new rules came after FIFA stopped overseeing football agents.

Maksims Uvarenko, a Latvian goalkeeper who plays for CSKA Sofia, has not been paid for three months. He has had to ask his parents to send him money to pay his rent...... He joined the Bulgarian club in January on an 18-month contract. Despite the money problems, Uvarenko said he is impressed by the fans and their strong support..... He told local media that the lack of salary is his biggest problem. He said he still hasn't received any money after being at the club for three months......... The name of the goalkeeper is Maksims Uvarenko, not Ukarov.

David Moore, 25, lost control and attacked another driver after leaving his home. He was angry because he was stuck in heavy traffic with Rafal Cegielka, 45,, who was picking up his child from St John's Primary School in Burnley, Lancashire. A court heard that Moore punched the father and then smashed his car with a hockey stick in front of young children. because he had a bad day and " saw red."

Spain lost 2-0 to Holland on Tuesday, reminding fans of their poor 2014 World Cup performance. Coach Vicente del Bosque is not worried about Spain’s third straight friendly loss, says Gerard Pique. This was the same Holland team that beat Spain 5-1 in the group stage of the 2014 World Cup in Brazil, ending Spain’s six-year reign as the top team in football. Spain had strong pressure in the second half, but couldn’t score. Holland scored two early goals and held on to win at the Amsterdam Arena.

A New York City mother, Ulrike Berger, 44, is believed to have fled to Germany with her seven-year-old daughter, Kaia, during a custody dispute. A court had ordered her not to leave the country with Kaia. Police say they believe the two boarded a flight from New York to Germany on March 22.... They last seen at Berger’s home in Boerum Hill, Brooklyn, on March 21, when Kaia’s father had her there for a weekend visit..

A large fire burned through dry heathland near the south coast.. Flames shot high into the air and thick smoke rose. The fire destroyed an area about the size of 100 football fields. It was after several days of storms that damaged trees and closed roads. The 70-ha area in Dorset was very dry because it's on a hill and water ran off. Fire investigators say the fire was started on purpose. It destroyed three parts of heathland: one half a hectare, one that was one hectare, and one that was 70 hectares..

Emergency services got 600 calls every hour last night as people across Britain celebrated the New Year. Paramedics were very busy, and in Cambridge a military field hospital was set up to help drunk partygoers. The London Ambulance Service said they were handling over 600 calls per hour — that’s more than three times the usual number. In Manchester, a man fell on the pavement next to an ambulance while two people walked past eating a late-night takeaway. In another scene in Manchester, a man was leaning against a doorway, looking very unwell, while two women passed by celebrating the New Year.

Liverpool goalkeeper Simon Mignolet said his mental strength helped him get back to form after he was dropped in December. Mignolet was left out of the team " indefinitely" by manager Brendan Rodgers after a bad spell. He returned quickly when backup keeper Brad Jones got a thigh injury. The 27-year-old Belgian player said he stayed positive even though he was upset about losing his place. Mignolet made a save from a free kick in a recent match against Swansea. He also told FourFourTwo, "I was positive."

Large hailstones, about the size of plums, fell over the southern U States on Tuesday. people ran outside to film the unusual weather. Arke USA, a Twitter user from Bryant, Arkansas, recorded the hail hitting his backyard and falling into his swimming pool. The video shows the hailstones falling fast, with many breaking when they hit the ground. Even though the temperature was around 80 degrees, the hard hailstones didn’t melt quickly. Within seconds, the patio was completely covered in white hail.

A group of nine people on a replica pirate schooner called the Liana's Ransom had to leave the ship after it lost power in heavy seas off the coast of Maine.. The Coast Guard rescued them by life boat on Tuesday. The ship had engine problems around 1:35 a.m. on Monday and then the sails were tangled around the mast. The ship was left floating 30 miles east of Portland. The crew members jumped from the ship to safety.

Strange blue glowing algae have been seen along Australia's east coast. The photos were taken in Jervis Bay, on the south coast of New South Wales. The bright blue light was seen on a popular beach. The glow came from millions of tiny plankton that give off light. Photographer Andy Hutchinson said it looked like a magical, otherworldly scene. A similar glowing effect was seen at Sydney's Manly Beach in August 2014. An oceanography expert told Daily Mail Australia that the algae are not dangerous and there is no reason to worry.

A 17-year-old boy named Rahul Kumar was drunk when he climbed into the lion enclosure at the Kamla Nehru Zoological Park in Ahmedabad, western India. He jumped over the fence and ran toward the lions, shouting, "Today I kill a lion!" He had been sitting near the enclosure when he suddenly ran in. Security officers had to rescue him. Afterward, he said he was drunk and thought he had a good chance against the lions.

A 2-year-old boy in Nanchang, Jiangxi Province, survived a fall from a fifth-floor window after landing on a car parked below.. His father said the boy probably fell while sleepwalking. The incident happened last Saturday. A hotel worker across the street said she heard a loud noise around midnight, which she thought was a car crash.

Drew Miller of the Red Wings says he’s ready to play again just one day after getting a serious cut to his face that could have damaged his eyesight.. " said at practice on Wednesday. "I feel very lucky the skate didn't hit my eye." Miller was skating with a full face mask during practice. He has a deep red wound on his face that needed 5 to 60 stitches to close. The Detroit Free Press reports the cut went through several layers of skin. The injury left a scar across his eye, but he did not lose any eyesight.

Filipe Luis says he wants to stay at Chelsea until his contract ends, even though Atletico Madrid might bring him back in the summer. He signed a three-year deal when he moved from Atletico last July, but hasn’t been able to secure the left-back spot at Chelsea. Atletico hopes this could help them get him back, but Luis said, “I’m happy at Chelsea. I want to stay at the club until the end of my contract.”

A Reading football fan, Charlie Sumner, 20, could face a three-year ban after he ran onto the pitch topless during his first ever game at Madejski Stadium.. He did four front somersaults on the pitch while his team, was leading 3-0, and landed on his back. He was then tackled by stadium staff. Sumner said the game was a " brilliant experience," but now risks a three-year ban for his actions..

A video has been released showing a dangerous moment when a van carrying several men on its roof flipped over while turning sharply on a road near Salé, Morocco.. About six people were riding on top of the van when it lost control and rolled onto its side at high speed. The video, filmed from a car behind the van, shows the vehicle swining wildly from side to side on a busy road. It is believed to have been carrying football fans. The incident happened on a road that appears to have two lanes in each direction..

England have been placed in Group D of the UEFA Under-17 European Championships, which will be held in Bulgaria in May. The group also includes the Republic of Ireland, Holland, and Italy. England is the defending champion after winning the title last year in Malta by beating Holland in a penalty shootout. The team must beat Holland again to reach the quarter-finals.. The tournament has expanded from eight to 16 teams for the first time. Danny Collinge celebrates after scoring his first goal for England against Norway in the qualifying matches.

An angry elephant sprayed water from its trunk at a buffalo bull that came too close while the elephant was resting with its family near a small pool in Kruger National Park, South Africa. The bull was drinking from the pool, and the elephant didn’t like how close it got. The elephant tried to spray the bull with water to make it go away, but missed. The baby elephant stayed close to its parent for safety. The moment was caught on camera. Video available below.

Michael Thorpe, a former pub landlord, has had his 2006 conviction overturned after eight years. He was originally found guilty of showing Premier League football matches on foreign TV channels without permission. The matches were shown at the Stoke Inn in Plymouth, Devon, in November 2006. Mr Thorpe, now 55, says the long legal fight has cost him dearly—he lost his pub and a result. He says he has paid a heavy price for clearing his name.

The Irish Football Association hopes that damage to its home stadium, Windsor Park in Belfast, won’t stop the team from playing its important Euro 2016 qualifier against Romania in June. On Tuesday morning, workers found cracks in the West Stand and the area was closed off while engineers checked the damage. An IFA spokesman said the association learned on Tuesday morning that the West Stand had been damaged during the night.. The damage happened at Windsor Park in Belfast on Monday night.

A football fan is at risk of a three-year ban after running onto the pitch at topless during his first game at the stadium.. Charlie Sumner, 20, made a solo pitch invasion at Reading's Madejski Stadium during the FA Cup quarter-final replay against Bradford City last month. The Reading fan, whose team was leading 3-0 at the time, did four front somersaults on the pitch, landing on his back each time, before being stopped by stadium staff.

A man driving a BMW with five children in the car was arrested today after a young student was hit and killed while walking to the library. The victim, Hina Shamim, was 2. She died near the University of Kingston in London last night, just weeks before her second birthday. Friends have left flowers at the scene and remembered her as a much-loved girl who was kind and special. Hina, who was nicknamed "Hyena" and came from Peterborough, was killed after being hit while walking a short way from her home to the library..

A mother and her teenage daughter were arrested after a video showed them fighting with a student at Langham Creek High School in Houston. The incident happened on Tuesday and was caught on camera. The mother, whose name has not been released, was upset because she believed the student had been bullying her daughter. According to Channel 2, the mother is wearing a black top and is on the right in the video. The student, who was attacked, is in the center and wearing white. The video was posted online.

Stoke chief executive Tony Scholes hopes the club can keep goalkeeper Asmir Begovic, who is in the final year of his contract. The Bosnia international has often been linked with other clubs since joining Stoke. The current contract runs for just over two months, but Scholes believes Stoke can meet Begovic’s goals. "Asmir is a great goalkeeper and we really want him to stay," Scholes said. "When you have top players, it's normal for people to talk about their future."

A bus driver in Auckland, New Zealand, was criticized by his boss after being caught on video reading a newspaper while driving......... A passenger filmed the driver on the bus and sent the video to the company, Ritchies Coachlines, with a complaint. In the video, the driver is seen turning the pages of a newspaper while the bus is moving.... The bus slows down at traffic lights, and the driver looks at the paper. The company's boss, Andrew Ritchie, said he was ashamed of the driver's behavior and called him a "complete idiot."

West Ham manager Sam Allardyce has said that Winston Reid will be fit for the match against Leicester City on Saturday. But Enner Valencia will not play. Reid has been out since he hurt his hamstring in a 1-0 loss to Chelsea on March 4. He has now returned to full training during the international break....... Valencia missed West Ham's last two games against Arsenal and Sunderland due to a strange toe injury he got at home in mid-March. But Allardyce says he is still not ready to play..

Five days before Brittany Huber and John Redman were supposed to get married last May, a terrible car accident on a Georgia highway killed Brittany. John survived, but his body was badly injured. Doctors told him he might spend the rest of his life in a nursing home, using a wheelchair. The 25-year-old assistant basketball coach at Dalton State College had a very hard time ahead. But he beat the odds, recovered, and on March 24, he helped lead his team to a championship title.

Lucas (on the left) was seen with Liverpool captain Steven Gerrard at Sunday’s All-Star charity game at Anfield. Liverpool midfielder Lucas Leiva is trying to get back to his best level after being injured.. The Brazil player had a strong run of 16 starts in 19 games from late November, which was when Liverpool’s results improved. But he missed 10 games after a groin injury in February’s Merseyside derby. He didn’t play in the loss to Manchester United just before the international break, which was the first league game since mid-December. However, he did play the full 90 minutes in Sunday’s charity game at Anfield.

Tired of boring father-daughter photos? One photographer has found a fun, unusual way to make them better. Japanese photographer Yûki Aoyama made a new series of pictures showing serious-looking teenagers standing next to their dads, jumping in the air. In each photo, the daughter looks straight at the camera and smiles, while her dad makes a big, dramatic pose. These photos are from Yûki Aoyama’s latest book,, which is called *Daughter and Salary Man*. The book is about 37 years old.

Police are looking for a man between 50 and 60 years old. He is 5ft 9in to 6ft tall, and was wearingin black clothes. He is a white man with greying black hair and glasses. He is suspected of robbing a Lloyds Bank in Fairwater, Cardiff at 12.30pm. The robbery was in broad daylight, and he took £3,000 in cash. No one was hurt. Police have shown CCTV pictures of the man and believe the public can help identify him.

The Court of Arbitration for Sport has removed Morocco's ban from the next two African Cup of Nations tournaments.. The ban had been imposed by the Confederation of African Football (CAF). Morocco was kicked out of the 2017 and 2019 tournaments and fined $1 million by CAF. CAF also asked Morocco to pay $9 million more in compensation, after Morocco withdrew as hosts because of concerns about the Ebola virus. Morocco had originally been set to host the tournament, but pulled out. The event was later held in Equatorial Guinea and won by Ivory Coast. Now, Morocco is allowed to take part in the next two African Cup of Nations tournaments,. after the ban was overturned.

Tom Boyd thinks Jason Denayer has done so well on loan at Celtic that he is now ready to fight for a spot at Manchester City next season.... This could make it hard for Celtic manager Ronny Deila, who wanted Denayer to stay another year. But Boyd sees a good side: Denayer’s success shows other young players that coming to Celtic can help them grow. The 19-year-old defender has played well this season and has already earned his first cap for Belgium, playing in a Euro 2016 qualifier against Cyprus.

Andros Townsend scored a great goal for England, helping them draw 1-1 with Italy in a friendly match in Turin. This was a strong response to critics, including Paul Merson, who had doubted him. Townsend, 23, has had a mixed season and hasn’t yet matched his earlier form. But England manager Roy Hodgson has kept trusting him. That faith was rewarded when Townsend scored England’s equalizer at Juventus Stadium. He celebrated with his Tottenham teammates, Ryan Mason and Kyle Walker.

Chinese property company Dalian Wanda Group has officially bought 20% of Spanish football team Atletico Madrid. The deal was confirmed at a special meeting on Tuesday, when the legal team for Wanda Madrid Investment signed the agreement to buy 726707 shares for €45 million (£32.8 million). The initial announcement was made in January, but two special meetings were needed to complete the deal. Wanda Group boss Wang Jianlin wants to grow Atletico's brand in Asia. . Atletico Madrid's manager Diego Simeone is speaking to reporters.

Antonio Conte said he was back to Turin for Italy's 1-1 draw against England brought back happy memories, even though he had received death threats before the match. Conte became Italy's manager in August after the national team failed to get past the group stage in the World Cup. the summer before. He has had a difficult first seven months in charge. Italy needed a late goal from Eder to tie Bulgaria 2-2 last Saturday. Conte was also threatened with death by Juventus fans after Claudio Marchisio got a knee injury the day before a Euro 2016 qualifier.

Ian Murray thinks that a potentially easier schedule could help Hibs overtake Rangers for second place in the Championship. with just one month left in the season. His Dumbarton team has already played both of his old clubs, Hibs and Rangers, this season and will face them again in the final weeks. Right now, Rangers are in better form — they beat Hibs and Cowdenbeath, while Hibs lost to Raith. But Murray doesn’t think this advantage will last. He believes Hibs could soon regain the upper hand. He also thinks Rangers may not be able to keep up their current pace through the final stretch of the season.

Liverpool goalkeeper Simon Mignolet took photos with pilots in an airplane cockpit when he came back to England after playing for Belgium in the Euro 2016 qualifiers against Cyprus and Israel. He was named in the match-day squad for both games, but did not play because Chelsea goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois was chosen as the starting keeper. Mignolet has 14 international caps. He shared the photos on his official Facebook page on Wednesday. The photo shows Mignolet (centre) standing with the pilots as he returns home.

A large country estate, including a Grade II-listed manor house and five cottages, is for sale for £6 million. It sits on 200 acres of land near Bridgnorth in Shropshire. The estate also has a swimming pool, tennis court, stables, and a cricket field. The main house, Chyknell Hall, has 11 bedrooms and was built in 1814. It has only been sold twice since then. The house is in the Regney style and is thought to appeal to famous people because the grounds are very private. The estate is being offered for sale at £6 million.

Two campus police officers in Dallas have been put on leave after a video showed them mistreating a group of four students, and arresting one after hitting him. The incident happened at El Centro College. Student Charles Adams filmed the event on his phone. He was smoking a cigarette when he saw what happened. The officers approached the students, who were high schoolers waiting for a bus outside the downtown Dallas campus, on Wednesday.

Kilmarnock's interim manager Gary Locke has been appointed to the role permanently after signing a three-year contract.. He previously managed Hearts and joined Kilmarnock last summer as assistant to Allan Johnston. He took charge of the team when Johnston left in early February. The 39-year-old has only lost once in his seven games in charge since then. He will speak to the media at a press conference on Friday morning. After the deal was signed, Locke shook hands with club chairman Jim Mann.

One of the most important games in German football happens this weekend. But this year’s match between Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich doesn’t have the same excitement as in past years. The game, now called Der Klassiker, used to be a major showdown, but that’s changed. Dortmund and Bayern have won the last five Bundesliga titles between them. Bayern are still expected to win this season too.. This time, though, the two teams are not close in the league table. They are three points apart and nine places apart in the standings. But even though the gap is bigger, the match still matters just as much as always. because it’s Dortmund vs. Bayern. Jurgen Klopp, the Dortmund manager, is celebrating with his players after their win against Hannover.

A 14-year-old schoolgirl was left at a busy airport after easyJet refused to let her board because she had two bags as hand luggage. She was crying at London Stansted Airport when she was told she couldn’t fly home to Spain. She offered to pay to check her second bag, but was told only credit cards would be accepted—even though she is too young to have one.

Gordon Robson, 26, killed his grandfather, John Potts, 45, with one hard punch to the back of the head. The punch was so strong it made a loud cracking sound. The attack happened after Robson had been drinking, shortly after his grandfather's funeral. It took place outside the NE38 Sports Bar in Washington, Tyne and Wear, in November. John Potts was a devoted father. Robson has a past history of violent behavior. He was sentenced to three and a half years in prison for the killing..

Scoring against your old team and making a perfect set-piece from training are two of the best moments in football. For Notts County player Ellen White, Thursday night was unforgettable because she did both in the same game against Arsenal in the Women's Super League. In the 26th minute, Notts County had a free kick near the edge of the box. Laura Bassett and Alex Greenwood seemed to mess up the play, with Bassett almost running into Greenwood. This caused confusion. Ellen White then spun near the box and kicked the free kick straight into the corner of the goal, scoring against her former team.

High school girls in China are doing military-style dagger drills. Each girl shouts "kill, stab, slash, and jab" as they do eight movements in a high-energy knife-fighting exercise. The girls, aged 16 to 18, are trained by former special forces soldier Inspector Tan at the 27th March Huizhou Integrated High School. The school has 68 girls in the program. The knives used are not real, for safety. This was confirmed by school official Huang Anruo.

We spend about one-third of our lives sleeping, but most people don’t think about what their mind and body really need during sleep to feel rested.... The Sleep Health Foundation says 1 in 3 Australians say they don’t get enough sleep every day.. According to Professor David Hillman, not getting enough sleep means you have to make up for it, or you won’t be able to function well all week. A study found that 30 percent of Australians say they lack sleep daily.. The average adult should sleep about 8 hours a night, and between 7 to 9 hours is normal.

A video has been shared on Facebook showing a fight between neighbours in a Perth suburb that turned violent. The clip shows an angry woman yelling racist remarks over a fence at a group of men she seems to believe are of African descent. The woman then goes into her neighbour's front yard, holding a metal crowbar. She shouts at the men and swings the crowbar at them. The men respond by picking up their own weapons, and a fight breaks out. The woman shouts, "I don't deal with monkeys, go on now you f*****g monkeys."

A lot of people are watching 19-year-old Valencia left back Jose Luis Gaya. With Manchester City, Arsenal, and Chelsea all interested in signing him this summer. Sportsmail’s Pete Jenson is looking at the Spanish under-21 player. Why are English clubs so interested? His buy-out clause is £13.5m. That’s not much compared to the £27m it cost to buy Luke Shaw, who is the same age and Gaya. So it makes sense to be interested. But there are still doubts about whether he’s ready for the Premier League. Gaya ( right) playing for Valencia in a La Liga game against Sevilla earlier this season.

Police in Oregon are asking the public for help identifying a motorcyclist who helped stop a man who allegedly threatened two teenagers with a gun. The incident happened in Salem. The man, Edward West, 59, is said to have pointed a handgun at two teens and told them, "get ready to die." At that moment, a man on a green motorcycle arrived and used his helmet to knock the gun from the man's hand. This allowed the teens to run away. The motorcyclist's identity is still unknown.

Tim Sherwood is telling Ron Vlaar to show he still deserves to be captain as Aston Villa prepare for their match at Old Trafford. Vlaar has returned from injury and will play a key role as the team fights to avoid relegation. Sherwood also reminded Vlaar that some people may have forgotten his strong performances in the 2020 World Cup, where he helped the Netherlands reach the semi-finals, even though he missed a penalty in the quarter-final shoot-out against Argentina. interest from Manchester United followed that performance. Vlaar is back in action and will help Villa in their fight to stay in the league.

Tim Sherwood says he is not worried about Aston Villa’s possible summer takeover. He plans to build his own team for next season, as long as the club avoids relegation. Randy Lerner is reportedly talking to a potential buyer, and if a new owner takes over, questions may arise about Sherwood’s future. But Sherwood is concentrating only on helping Villa stay in the league. After that, he will work on his long-term plans during the summer break. The Villa manager says he’s not concerned about the takeover talks. Christian Benteke scored and celebrated as Villa beat Sunderland last month.

Celtic have long wanted Manchester City to let Jason Denayer return on loan to Parkhead next season. But that doesn't mean it will happen. On Thursday, City's manager Manuel Pellegrini said his young Academy players aren't ready to play in the first team.. So, Denayer and others like him might have to come back from loan deals soon. to help out.. Denayer has done well during his loan spell at Celtic this season.

Southampton manager Ronald Koeman is waiting for a clearer date on when Fraser Forster will return before deciding if he needs to sign another goalkeeper in the summer.  
Forster had knee surgery after hurting himself badly during Southampton’s 2-0 win over Burnley about two weeks ago.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Experts have given estimates that he could be out for between four and 11 months.  
  
  
  
  
  
Koeman is not giving a more exact time for Forster’s return.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
He says Kelvin Davis is able to to fill in for him for now.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
But he also says he might need to get another goalkeeper if Forster’s recovery takes longer than expected.

Rotherham manager Steve Evans was angry on the touchline during their Sky Bet Championship game against Birmingham, because his team was not given a penalty. Rotherham were fighting to avoid relegation. Birmingham scored first through Robert Tesche and then Clayton Donaldson, giving them a lead. Matt Derbyshire scored one for Rotherham, who were fourth from bottom. Later, Rob Kiernan handled the ball on the edge of the box, and Derbyshire fell down inside the area. But referee Dean Whitestone did not give a penalty. Evans was clearly upset, and Birmingham went on to win the match. Robert Tesche, of Birmingham City, celebrated his goal.

Virgil van Dijk is worrying about his national team. The Netherlands have already let in more goals in five Euro 2016 qualifiers than they did in the whole last World Cup qualifying campaign. And Guus Hiddink, the manager, still hasn’t contacted him. Van Dijk was in two national team squads last year. But he’s often moved forward and then back again. When the Netherlands drew 1-1 with Turkey, he was relaxing in the Arabian Gulf, hanging out with club teammates instead. He’s been playing well for Celtic, but still didn’t get called up to the Dutch national team.

Celtic have complained to the SFA about the ticket prices for their Scottish Cup semi-final against Inverness, which is happening later this month at Hampden. The match is set for 12:15pm on Sunday, April 18. Fans from Inverness Caledonia (Caley Thistle) are angry because the game is before the first train from Inverness arrives in Glasgow.... The prices are £23 for adults in the North and South stands, and £15 for adults in the East Stand, £5 for concession tickets. Celtic say they are unhappy with these prices.

Rangers' interim chairman, Paul Murray, said on Thursday that the club's removal from the stock exchange was completely due to actions taken by past board members.. The team will have to leave the Alternative Investment Market (AIM) because they couldn’t find a new nominated advisor (Nomad) to meet the rules. Murray says the new board’s future plans won’t change, and planned investments will still happen. He repeated that past board members were fully to blame for the club’s removal from the stock exchange.

Wayne Rooney and his England teammates were disappointed with how poorly they started their match against Italy on Tuesday night. at the Juventus Stadium. It was their second meeting since the World Cup, and this time it was a friendly game. England had won seven games in a row, so many people had high hopes. But in the first half, Roy Hodgson's team played badly and lacked energy. Italy scored first when Graziano Pelle headed in a goal. In the end, the game finished 1-1. Rooney said he and the other England players were upset by their first-half performance.

Dundee United's board has responded to strong criticism from two major supporters' groups, – Arabtrust and the Federation of Dundee United Supporters Clubs. These groups say they are shocked that 25% of the £6.3 million in transfer fees for Ryan Gauld, Andrew Robertson, Stuart Armstrong, and Gary Mackay-Steven was paid as commission to unknown people.. The groups also questioned chairman Stephen Thompson's claim about how much he has invested in the club. The board says their success on the pitch shows their work is effective.

Gary Locke will be officially named Kilmarnock’s permanent manager on Friday, exactly eight weeks after he was asked to take over until the end of the season. The club will make the announcement on Friday morning. Locke, who previously managed Hearts, will sign a three-year contract. He is 39 years old. On Thursday, he thanked the players for their hard work, which helped him gain the support of new chairman Jim Mann. Since February, Locke took over as caretaker manager after Allan Johnston left. Kilmarnock will confirm Gary Locke as their new permanent manager on Friday.

Chinese parents often want their children to become child prodigies — like 10-year-olds going to university or 4-year-olds who dance just like Michael Jackson. Now a new young star is gaining attention. A video is spreading online in China showing a small boy with amazing basketball skills, even better than some pro players. The boy is five years old and his name is Mai Zizhuo. He has been playing basketball since he was 2 and a half, according to People's Daily Online. The video starts with him scoring basket after basket, then running while dribbling two basketballs at once.

Bayern Munich will miss versatile left-back David Alaba for about seven weeks as he recovers from a torn knee ligament.. Alaba, who had already been out for three months earlier this season due to a partial ligament tear in his right knee,, was injured during Austria’s 1-1 draw with Bosnia on Tuesday. 'I am very disappointed,' said the 22-year-old. 'But I have a big goal — to be back for the final game of the season.' Alaba was tackled by Emir Spahic during Austria’s 1-1 draw against Bosnia-Herzegovina.

Hull KR have signed experienced Australian forward Dane Tilse to replace Michael Weyman and Ryan Bailey, who both left the club. Tilse, who is 6ft 7in and weighs over 17 stone, is 30 years old and has played 200 games in Australia. has signed a two-and-a-half-year contract with Hull KR. He will join the team as soon as he gets the required paperwork, after the Canberra Raiders agreed to release him. Tilse will also be playing alongside his old Canberra teammate, Terry Campese, who is now Hull KR’s captain and has just signed a two-year contract extension. Tilse is taking over Weyman’s role, as Weyman retired last month because of injury.

Livingston manager Mark Burchill thinks midfielder Darren Cole wants to play in Sunday’s Petrofac Cup final, even though his cousin, Shaun Cole, died tragically just a week ago. Shaun, who was 22, was found dead on a Miami street. Police believe he was hit by a car and killed in a hit-and-run. He was a soldier who had served in Afghanistan and was on leave from the army. He was visiting Florida for a holiday and had been to a music festival before he was found with a head injury. The injury was fatal. Mark Burchill hopes Darren Cole will play for Livingston on Sunday.

Alan Smith has denied reports that Liverpool fans attacked the ambulance he was in after he suffered a serious injury during a 2006 FA Cup match between Manchester United and Liverpool. Smith broke his leg and dislocated his ankle while trying to stop a free-kick by John Arne Riise. The match took place at Anfield in February 2006. At the time, some media reports said fans threw bottles, beer glasses, and stones at the ambulance, and even rocked the vehicle as it drove away. This content may be disturbing.

Celtic are interested in signing Hearts captain Danny Wilson this summer. He is a former Rangers and Liverpool player. Celtic may offer £400,000 for him. Wilson has 12 months left on his contract. Hearts owner Ann Budge says the club does not need to sell him. They are not in a hurry to do so.

Ronny Deila says Celtic won’t risk their Champions League hopes by doing another tough pre-season tour. He blames last summer’s series of matches in the US, Austria, and Germany for their 4-1 defeat to Legia Warsaw in the qualifying round. Celtic earns good money from pre-season games and has played in Australia and the Far East in recent years. Deila and player Nir Bitton left the pitch after losing to Legia Warsaw. A return to the US this July is still possible.

Franck Ribery has said that reports linking Wolfsburg’s Kevin de Bruyne to a move to Bayern Munich to replace him or his teammate Arjen Robben are wrong.. De Bruyne, who spent two years at Chelsea mostly on loan before joining Wolfsburg, has scored nine goals this season and leads the Bundesliga in assists with 16— seven more than the next player. But Ribery says that even though De Bruyne is playing well, he’s not the right type of player to fit under Bayern’s manager Pep Guardiola. because his style of play is different from his own and from Robben’s.

The girlfriend of an Arizona State University football player, who was suspended after accusing him of abuse, has now said she lied. She said her mood swings caused her to make up the story. Davon Durant, a strong linebacker at ASU, was arrested on domestic violence charges after his girlfriend, Kelsi Langley, said he hit her in the face and choked her during an argument in his car on March 7. After the arrest, Durant — who transferred from a college in Kansas and was a five-star recruit — was suspended from the football team indefinitely. He could also be expelled from school.

What could be more exciting than meeting your idol?  
ing your idol at a Starbucks, wearing a shirt with their name on it, and having your photo posted on their Instagram. A young boy got to do all that when he met Justin Verlander, the pitcher for the Detroit Tigers. Verlander took a selfie with the boy, who was wearing a dark blue shirt that had Verlander’s name and his jersey number, 35, on the back. The photo was shared on Verlander’s Instagram. See video below.

Eden Hazard said that playing so many games this season might have made him too tired to play his best.. He was substituted after just 66 minutes in Belgium’s 1-0 win over Israel on Tuesday. Hazard has played in 48 games this season for both club and country,, missing only five matches for Chelsea. He was a key player in Chelsea’s push for the Premier League title. But Belgium had a tough time winning against Israel in the European Championship qualifiers. Group B. Hazard was taken off by manager Marc Wilmots with 28 minutes left because he was struggling to beat his opponent, Orel Dgani.

Police found 20 grams of marijuana hidden inside a leg of lamb in the Northern Territory.. The meat was suspicious, so police used an x-ray and discovered the drugs. The lamb was meant to be sent to a company at Darwin Airport and then shipped to the Tiwi Islands, about 100kms to the north.

Former Premier League footballer Clarke Carlisle has said he and and his wife, Gemma, have separated. He is still dealing with depression after trying to take his own life in December.... He said he has left the family home in Yorkshire, where he lived with Gemma for 14 years. He was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving two days before his suicide attempt... The couple were together in 2013.

Arsenal legend Paul Merson had to admit he was wrong after criticizing Andros Townsend's England call-up. The Tottenham winger came on as a substitute and scored a brilliant goal to equalize in England's 1-1 draw against Italy in Turin. This goal was a strong response to Merson's earlier comment in his Sky Sports column, which said, "If Andros Townsend can get in, then it opens it up for anybody." Townsend scored England's equalizer in the friendly match against Italy on Tuesday night. He celebrated with his Tottenham teammates, Ryan Mason and Kyle Walker. The comment was published in his Sky Sports column.

Cesc Fabregas, the Chelsea midfielder, has a habit of playing poorly in the second half of the season. On Tuesday, he was one of the worst players on the field during Spain's 2-0 loss to Holland. The 27-year-old had earlier in the week said he was happy in southwest London. but his performance has dropped sharply since Christmas, when he looked like he would break the Premier League record for most assists.

Six people have been arrested in Dover this morning on suspicion of terrorism offences linked to Syria, police said.  
  
  
  
Five men and one woman were taken into custody around 8 a.m in the departure area of the south coast port.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Four of the men, all in their 20s, are from Birmingham in the West Midlands. Another man, aged 26, and a woman, aged 23, who have no fixed address, were also arrested.

Get ready to buy something — the strongest urge to treat yourself happens today at 2:52 pm. A study says that people in the UK spend an average of £62 each week on treats. This urge is strongest at lunchtime today. Things people buy as treats can be small, like a chocolate bar or a glass of wine, or bigger, like designer clothes and shoes. The study was done by the website VoucherCodes.co.uk. And it found that men spend 33 more each month than women on treating themselves.

Arsène Wenger is so respected and clearly very smart that sometimes you agree with something he says, only to realize later it sounds true but isn’t really based on strong evidence. This often happens after a bad game, when he points out that Arsenal’s defense is actually statistically strong — which is true. But last week, he was talking about player quotas. Specifically, he was reacting to FA chairman Greg Dyke’s idea to raise the number of homegrown players in a Premier League squad from 8 to 2.

Charlie Austin has shared how his friend Joey Barton ignored him on his first day at Queens Park Rangers, before realising he had made a mistake. The two men are now close friends. Austin has had a strong first season in the Premier League, and has scored 15 goals, which has made him a possible candidate to play for England in the future. Although their friendship is well known, their first meeting was not a good start.

This dog saved his owner from a cold and muddy grave.. The black dog was filmed on Saturday afternoon at the Clarence J. Brown Dam and Reservoir in Springfield, Ohio, as he took a rescue rope to his owner. The man, whose name is not known, was pulled to safety by firefighters after being in water close to freezing point (just above 0 degrees Celsius) for nearly two hours. He had stuck waist-deep in mud while trying to get back some duck hunting gear.. He managed to call 911 with his cell phone, but he was trapped.. First responders couldn't send a boat because the river was too shallow.

Juventus coach Massimiliano Allegri says he doesn’t expect to be fully accepted by the fans until he wins a title with the club.. He joined Juventus last summer, after being fired by AC Milan. Since then, he has done nothing wrong, leading Juventus to a strong lead in the race for the Serie A trophy.... He replaced Antonio Conte last summer. On Saturday, Juventus will play at home against Empoli, aiming for three more points. Juventus are currently top of Serie A, and Allegri is coaching them from the touchline.

Nathan Redmond had only been on the pitch for six minutes when he made a key play in this close match. — it could turn out to be very important. Steven Whittaker saw the chance and passed the ball perfectly to Redmond, who was running down the right side. The ball stayed just inside the touchline as it moved forward. Redmond used his speed to quickly beat Joe Bennett, and sent a low cross toward the back post. Bradley Johnson hit the ball into the net to score the winning goal in the second half. at the Amex Stadium. Johnson celebrated after scoring.

For people in Celoron, New York, the statue of their hometown star, Lucile Ball, is not funny. They have been upset by it for six years.. The town put up the statue in 2009. It shows Ball with a face that many locals think looks nothing like her. The statue is based on a scene from her show, "I Love Lucy," where she plays a drunk woman selling a health tonic. The statue looks so bad to many people that a Facebook page called "We Love Lucy! Get Rid of this Statue" has gotten more than 600 likes. The statue is called "monstrous" by some residents.

South Sydney hooker Issac Luke is facing a homophobic complaint after he posted a rude comment on social media. This happened after he was targeted by fans of the Canterbury Bulldogs. The 27-year-old posted a heartfelt message on his Instagram on Saturday, trying to find a young Rabbitohs fan who was attacked at ANZ Stadium in Sydney. The rugby league player wanted to donate a jersey to the boy, as a kind gesture. This was to help after the boy was taken to hospital following a fight that happened during a match. The donation was planned for the Easter long weekend.

People who fear spiders should be careful — this might scare you. A man in Victoria was shocked when a large huntsman spider crawled out from inside his car door handle. The video, filmed in Wangaratta, northeast Victoria, shows the man walking up to his black Holden Ute and spraying insect repellent on the door. The spider comes out from under the handle after being sprayed. He says calmly, “Get out, you bastard.” But when the spider’s hairy legs suddenly appear, he screams and jumps back in fear.

Tottenham's manager, Mauricio Pochettino, says Harry Kane is as good as the legendary Gabriel Batistuta. He also says he will support Kane if he ever has a bad run. Kane scored just 79 seconds after coming on in his first England game against Lithuania. at Wembley. That put him just two goals away from 30 for the season.... England's manager, Roy Hodgson, is trying to keep the pressure on Kane low. Kane has risen fast. After being on loan at Leicester and Norwich, he finally made it into Tottenham's first team.

A former footballer who ran a £30 million investment scheme and lived like a millionaire is now surviving on handouts, a court has heard. Michael McIndoe played for Bristol City and Wolverhampton Wanderers. He tricked other footballers into the scheme by promising them a 20 per cent return. The scheme failed because of growing debts, and McIndoe was declared bankrupt in October last year with over £2 million in debt. The former footballer, who was known as 'Mr Big' in Marbella and was famous for partying with glamorous women, is now being pursued by creditors in court.

In an interview with Mundo Deportivo, Nedved said Pogba will not be leaving the club.. But he also said he was happy Juventus did not face Barcelona in the Champions League quarter-finals.. Nedved, who is now a director at Juventus, played for the club and is a Czech former player. He confirmed Pogba will not move to Barcelona.

A man who has a criminal record for sex offenses was reportedly run over by his girlfriend after she said she caught him abusing a 2-year-old girl.. James Oliver, 48, was seriously hurt in the leg after he was hit by a car driven by Linda Currier, 33. Police found Oliver in the driveway of a house in Noblesboro, Maine, on Saturday night, according to NBC News. Authorities say the two had an argument inside the house after Currier saw Oliver allegedly trying to sexually harm the little girl.

Liverpool's target, goalkeeper Neto, is also wanted by PSG and several clubs in Spain, meaning Brendan Rodgers faces strong competition to sign him, according to Neto’s agent, Stefano Castagna. Not everyone should drive a $50,000 car. That’s the message from a video posted by YouTube user Richard Stewart. showing a Porsche Cayman losing control after a green light in Prince Edward Island, Canada. The sports car swerveded sharply, then hit the concrete median. One wheel came off before the car stopped. The court heard he lied about making rent payments to the club's landlord, even though the club was actually getting its building for free.

Allardyce worked with Pearson when he was manager at Newcastle in 2007, and they will meet again when West Ham play Leicester at the King Power Stadium on Saturday. Tottenham defender Ben Davies says he won’t let personal feelings get in the way when he plays against his Wales teammate Sam Vokes at Burnley on Sunday. The match is important for both teams. Sam Vokes scored against Tottenham in the FA Cup earlier this season, and that game was at Turf Moor, where he celebrated after equalising in the third round. Neil Redfearn is thinking about whether he will stay as manager of Leeds United after the club suspended his assistant, Steve Thompson on Thursday. Leeds took two months to hire Thompson, but he was told in a letter from director of football Nicola Salerno that he would be suspended until the end of the season. This effectively ends his time at Elland Road after just 105 days.. Thompson has been told he will be suspended until his contract ends, and the club will not renew his contract. Leeds United assistant manager Steve Thompson has been suspended by the club.

John Carver says he might use a whip to motivate his Newcastle players ahead of Sunday’s Tyne-Wear derby at the Stadium of Light. Newcastle have lost their last four matches against Sunderland. Carver, who was assistant to Alan Pardew during those losses, says Sunderland played harder than Newcastle in those games. He says it's not good that Sunderland have outworked the Magbies. David Templeton has strongly criticized the training methods used at Rangers under managers Ally McCoist and Kenny McDowall. The Rangers winger, David Templeton, is very positive about how McCall has improved the team.

Celta Vigo player Nolito says Lionel Messi should stay away from the match and instead enjoy the Spanish beach. instead of risking his foot injury. Messi has been training after a minor foot problem and is expected to be fit for the game. But Nolito, 28, says Messi should not play. He joked, "I guess he'll come, but he can spend the day at the beach as far as I'm concerned. I'll give his dad a call soon." Messi is expected to play for Barcelona against Celta Vigo after recovering from his foot injury. Barcelona's forward was seen training with teammate Javier Mascherano on Thursday.

Robbie Neilson says players like captain Danny Wilson will only leave Hearts if he thinks it’s the right decision for the club........ Neilson also said that the club’s players will only be sold if the price is right and he agrees. He added that it’s normal for other clubs to show interest in promoted players,.. He made these comments ahead of Hearts’ Championship game against Rangers at Ibrox.

Sam Allardyce has warned Brendan Rodgers that giving Raheem Sterling a big new contract could cause problems with the rest of the Liverpool team..... He thinks if Sterling gets paid more than the £100,000-a-week offer he already had, his teammates might demand higher pay too. But Allardyce doesn’t blame Sterling, who earns £35,000 a week at Liverpool, for wanting to get the most he can......... He says there are so few young, talented players coming through that clubs are paying huge wages to sign any good ones they can....... Blackpool are talking about signing Austria defender Thomas Piermayr, who is 25. He has been training with the Championship club this week. Tony Pulis wants to talk to West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace after the team is safe in the Premier League......... With Arsenal looking to sign Raheem Sterling and Walcott's contract ending next summer, Wright fears the team could lose a key player.

Roberto Martinez believes Ross Barkley can become an even more important player for Everton and England after overcoming his second-season slump at Goodison Park. Barkley has had a mixed season for Everton, affected by being in England’s World Cup squad last summer and by a knee injury that delayed his comeback. But England manager Roy Hodgson still trusts the 21-year-old. Martinez says Barkley’s two substitute appearances for England in the recent games against Lithuania and Italy show he’s ready to improve again.

England will not play in the Under-19 European Championships this summer after losing 2-1 to France in their final qualifier. France scored through Sehrou Guirassy and Gnaly Cornet, and despite a late goal from Fulham's Patrick Roberts, England couldn't get the win they needed. Newcastle midfielder Jonas Gutierrez is hoping to mark his return to the first team with a win in the local derby against Sunderland. The 3-year-old Argentinian has been back in the squad after recovering from testicular cancer. He’s played as a substitute in the last three games and has been warmly welcomed by teammates and fans. But he’s been on the losing side each time. Now he wants to end that streak as Newcastle try to recover from their worst run of four straight losses to Sunderland, in a match at the Stadium of Light on Sunday..

After a close game between South Sydney and Canterbury at ANZ Stadium in Sydney on Good Friday, NRL referees and officials were hit with plastic water bottles by angry fans. The Rabbitohs won 18-17 in the final minute. The match was controversial because the referees had penalised Bulldogs captain James Graham in the last minute, which gave the Rabbitohs the win. As the referees, officials, and players were leaving the field after the game, some fans threw bottles and shouted insults at them.

Leeds Rhinos captain Kevin Sinfield is leaving rugby league and will play for Yorkshire Carnegie in rugby union at the end of the season.

These sessions are led by a former police detective and a psychotherapist.

A new video shows homeless people reading mean tweets that were written about them. It’s likely to make you feel sad. The video was made by the advertising agency Leo Burnett Toronto for the charity Humans For Humans. It wants people to think more about how they see people who sleep on the streets. Many of the people cry while reading tweets like, "I hate the homeless, I don’t feel sorry for you," and "I saw a homeless girl across the street. I almost vomited." Scroll down for video.

George Boyd is the hardest-working player in the Barclays Premier League this season, having run 210.5 miles on the pitch. — This is the same distance as running from Burnley’s Turf Moor stadium to Crystal Palace’s Selhurst Park in south London. The journey from Turf Moor to Selhurst would normally take 69 hours to walk, according to Google Maps, but Boyd has covered it in less than 40 hours of playing time. George Boyd is the Barclays Premier League's hardest working player, clocking up 210.5 miles on the pitch.

Police have arrested the parents of a five-month-old baby who died yesterday. The baby’s father, 25, and mother, 25, both from Perry Barr, Birmingham, were taken into custody. Police were called to their home just before 1am yesterday morning after someone said the baby was having trouble breathing. The baby was taken to Birmingham Children's Hospital but died a few hours later. The death is being treated as suspicious. A post exam will be done today to find out the exact cause of death. The baby was found dead at the home in Perry Barr, Birmingham, yesterday afternoon.

Raheem Sterling is not being disloyal to Liverpool by delaying talks about a new contract until the summer, says player's agent Gordon Taylor. The 20-year-old England player has been offered what manager Brendan Rodgers called "an incredible deal," believed to be £100,000 a week. but talks have not have a deal. Sterling said in a TV interview he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool.

Anderson hasn't done well since leaving Manchester United and returning to Brazil. On Wednesday, his own mistake was overshadowed by a worse error from a teammate. The Brazilian midfielder was sent off in the first half for pushing Otacilio Neto, a striker from Ypiranga Erechim, when the ball wasn't involved. That push led to a fight, and Neto hit back with an elbow, so he was also sent off. But Anderson was lucky because his teammate, Fabricio, made a bigger mistake by swearing at their own fans. A seven-year-old boy was raped and set on fire by two teenagers after he went to buy food.. The teenagers took him to a remote area and raped him. When he tried to fight back, they set him on fire, police said. The boy, who had burns covering 10% of his body, managed to escape, according to Inspector Sasthe. The incident happened in Padma Nagar, Bhiwandi, a suburb of Mumbai. Police are now investigating the case.

A pug named Dug has made a surprising recovery after being bitten in the face by a ratt snake.. Dug and his owner, Lindsay Castro, were hiking on the Jurupa Hills trail in Fontana, California, on Thursday. They heard a rattling sound, so Lindsay stepped back. But Dug ran toward the sound and was bitten on the face. His face swelled up quickly, growing to twice its normal size. The video shows how badly he was swollen. Dug was curious and ran toward the sound, but it led to a dangerous situation. Despite the serious swelling, he is now recovering.

Jose Mourinho might one day surprise everyone by returning to manage Real Madrid, even after he left in a difficult way, according to Real defender Alvaro Arbeloa. Mourinho had a three-year stint at Real Madrid before moving back to Chelsea in 2013. He left Madrid under a cloud of rumors, including arguments with key players like club captain Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos, and Pepe. But Arbeloa, who has played in 25 first-team matches this season, says Real Madrid will always keep the door open for Mourinho to come back as manager...

Liverpool's hopes of qualifying for the Champions League ended on Saturday at the Emirates.. The team had been fighting hard, but now there is no chance. In a short 15-minute press conference, manager Brendan Rodgers acknowledged that the season was over. He did not hide that it had been tough. After coming close to winning the title last year, Liverpool are now out of the race. It is disappointing for a club that had hoped to return to greatness. But even though the season didn't go as planned, the team still feels like it is making progress under Rodgers.

Inter Milan coach Roberto Mancini was angry after his team drew 1-1 with Parma, who were at the bottom of the league. He cancelled the players' Easter day off and made them train early on Sunday morning. The first team trained at 8 a.m. local time. Club vice-president Javier Zanetti and sporting director Piero Ausilio were there. Mancini was upset with how the players acted after the draw. Most fans want to own a special piece of memorabilia from their favourite player or team. Small pieces of sports history can sell for thousands of pounds. He has been seen in toast, pancakes, crisps, and even ice cream. But a builder was shocked when he saw Jesus Christ on a piece of wood just a few days before Easter. Paddy Morrall from Keighley, near Bradford, noticed a full-size image of Jesus on a broken scaffolding board in Inverness, Scotland on Wednesday. The board was left out in the rain for several hours. Karim Benzema showed he’s more than just a football player. The Real Madrid star shared a video of himself rapping while driving his Bugatti Veyron. In the last four minutes of the Yorkshire derby, Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield drew 1-1. Sergiu Bus, who came on as a substitute, scored for Wednesday in the 86th minute. Stuart Dallas has come a long way since Mark Warburton found him playing part-time on a muddy field for Crusaders in Northern Ireland, where he was earning £770 a week. The 23-year-old, who had a strong performance for Northern Ireland earlier in the week, scored two brilliant goals as Brentford beat Fulham 4-1 on Good Friday. The win puts Brentford in a strong position as they prepare for their match against Nottingham Forest on Monday, aiming for more than just a play-off spot. Three years ago, Warburton noticed Dallas playing in a local game. Since then, Dallas has been a standout player this season, helping Brentford push hard for promotion to the Premier League.

Baseball is often seen as America's favorite sport,, so it's not surprising that many people feel strongly about their favorite professional team. A high school basketball star has won hearts by asking a girl with Down syndrome to be his prom date.. The boy, Trey Moses, is a senior at Eastern High School in Louisville, Kentucky, and will play for Ball State next year. The guide was created after BBC bosses asked an agency to study how emojis could be used in news and on social media. Mils Muliaina, a rugby player who won the World Cup, has been released on bail after being arrested on suspicion of sexual assault. The 34-year-old former All Black, who denies the accusations, was taken into custody last night. This happened after his team, Connact, lost 14-7 to Gloucester in the quarter final of the European Challenge Cup. He was injured during the match and was approached by police at Kingsholm Stadium. Muliaina, who has played 100 times for the All Blacks, was arrested in connection with an incident in Cardiff in March..

QPR are feeling confident ahead of their important Barclays Premier League match against Aston Villa on Tuesday. QPR had lost 13 of their previous 14 league games away from home, but they did win 4-1 against West Brom on Saturday. That victory ended a five-game losing streak, and they are still in 19th place, just three points from safety. QPR coach Chris Ramsey said after the win that his players stayed calm and focused. Eduardo Vargas (in the middle) celebrated with his teammates after scoring the first goal against West Brom. 'It's a great win for us,' Ramsey said in a press conference on Monday. 'The mood is good, and the team has been very professional.'

Arsene Wenger hasn't decided yet if he will offer Abou Diaby a new contract, but has said that Diaby might still have a future at Arsenal after this summer. even though he gets injured often. Diaby played in a practice match on Wednesday, his latest return from injury. But in the last five seasons, he has only played 2 games at Arsenal's stadium, the Emirates, and has spent long periods out because of injuries. Arsenal are playing Liverpool on Saturday at lunchtime. Wenger probably won't play Diaby in this important game, but he did say that Diaby could earn a new contract, possibly one where he only gets paid when he plays.

Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy aren’t playing, but that hasn’t stopped people from coming to the Shell Houston Open in Humble. The event is drawing record crowds. The last tournament before the Masters is exciting because of Phil Mickelson’s fun style and local favorite Jordan Spieth. Spieth, who is just 21, was criticized 18 months ago for leaving college and joining the PGA Tour as the 809th ranked player. He now is ranked fourth in the world. Now, no one is criticizing him.
